abstract: We propose a simple approach to treatment effect estimation in panel data that is valid when the number of time periods is small and the parallel trends condition is violated due to the presence of interactive fixed effects. The procedure allows the covariates to be affected by treatment and enables separation of the part of the estimated treatment effect that is due to the covariates from the part that is not. The asymptotic properties of the new approach are established, and their accuracy in small samples is investigated using Monte Carlo simulations. The procedure is illustrated using as an example the effect of increased trade competition on firm markups in China. We estimate that about half of the impact of China's entrance into the WTO on markup dispersion came from the changes in industry‐level productivity.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在面板数据中估计处理效应的简便方法，该方法在时间期数较少且因存在交互固定效应而违反平行趋势假设时依然有效。该程序允许协变量受处理影响，并能将估计处理效应中归因于协变量的部分与不归因于协变量的部分分离开来。我们确立了新方法的渐近性质，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究了其在小样本中的准确性。以中国贸易竞争加剧对企业加成率的影响为例，对该程序进行了说明。我们估计，中国加入WTO对加成率离散度影响中，约有一半来自行业层面生产率的变化。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Direct and Indirect Treatment Effects With Time‐Varying Covariates
title_zh: 时变协变量下的直接与间接处理效应

abstract: This paper examines how consumption taxes—through the taxation of input goods—can affect firms’ product mix decisions. We study India’s staggered transition from a sales tax, where there was the risk that intermediate inputs are taxed multiple times along the supply chain, to a value-added tax (VAT) that offered credits for taxes paid on inputs. Using detailed product-level data for manufacturing firms and a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that firms respond to the VAT adoption by narrowing their product scope through reducing vertical integration. These changes reflect a shift away from internal production of inputs, which was tax-induced under the sales tax system, toward greater specialization in the most profitable outputs. We also document that this vertical disintegration leads to lower manufacturing costs, greater profitability, improved investment efficiency, and higher firm value. Our findings highlight how consumption tax design can affect resource allocation within firms and that reducing tax burdens on input goods enhances operational efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了消费税——通过对投入品征税——如何影响企业的产品组合决策。我们研究了印度从销售税（在该税制下，中间投入品沿供应链存在多次被征税的风险）向增值税（VAT）的渐进式过渡，后者对投入品已缴税款提供抵扣。利用制造业企业详细的产品层面数据以及堆叠双重差分设计，我们发现企业通过减少纵向一体化来应对增值税的采纳，从而收窄其产品范围。这些变化反映了从销售税制度下因税收诱因而进行的内部投入品生产，转向对最具盈利能力的产出进行更大程度专业化的转变。我们还记录了这种纵向解体导致制造成本降低、盈利能力增强、投资效率提升以及企业价值提高。我们的研究结果凸显了消费税设计如何影响企业内部资源配置，并表明减轻投入品税收负担能够提升运营效率。
source_issue: Journal of Accounting and Economics, Volume 82, Issue 2
title: Consumption tax and corporate product mix decisions
title_zh: 消费税与企业产品组合决策

abstract: We examine whether brokerages cater to investors’ preferences and beliefs when producing analyst reports. We leverage a unique feature of the Chinese market — firms whose shares are dual-listed on a Chinese stock exchange (A-shares) as well as on the Hong Kong stock exchange (H-shares). We rely on the segmented nature of these two markets — with A-shares primarily traded by Chinese investors and H-shares by foreign investors — and the assumption that Chinese and foreign investors have divergent preferences and beliefs. We find that A-share analyst reports discuss more government-related issues, less valuation-related information, and have more positive tone and more optimistic recommendations relative to H-share reports, within the same firm-year-month and holding constant the brokerage firm. We find consistent evidence when examining differences between analyst reports written in Chinese versus English within the same share market. Overall, this paper presents evidence supporting a catering theory for the production of analyst research.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了券商在撰写分析师报告时是否会迎合投资者的偏好与信念。我们利用了中国市场的一个独特特征——公司股票同时在中国证券交易所（A股）和香港证券交易所（H股）双重上市。我们依赖于这两个市场的分割特性——A股主要由中国投资者交易，H股则由外国投资者交易——并假设中国与外国投资者持有不同的偏好和信念。我们发现，在同一公司-年-月内，且控制券商不变的情况下，A股分析师报告相比H股报告，更多讨论政府相关议题，较少涉及估值相关信息，且语气更为积极，推荐评级更为乐观。当我们在同一股票市场内比较中文与英文撰写的分析师报告时，也发现了相一致的结果。总体而言，本文提供了支持分析师研究报告生产中的迎合理论的证据。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
source_issue: Journal of Accounting and Economics, Volume 82, Issue 1
title: Do investor preferences affect analyst research? Evidence from Chinese dual-listed shares
title_zh: 投资者偏好是否影响分析师研究？来自中国双重上市股票的证据

abstract: How does the targeting of personal income tax cuts affect the output multiplier? This paper provides quantitative evidence using a heterogeneous-agent New-Keynesian model calibrated to match US distributions of income, wealth, marginal tax rates, and marginal propensities to consume. Labor supply is determined by household preferences on the intensive margin and search frictions on the extensive margin. The model evaluates tax cuts for the bottom-90 (B90%) and top-10% of the income distribution in national and cross-region settings, replicating influential empirical research designs. B90 tax cuts generate larger output effects while incentive effects play a central role in transmission.
abstract_zh: 个人所得税减税的目标定位如何影响产出乘数？本文利用一个校准至美国收入、财富、边际税率及边际消费倾向分布的异质性主体新凯恩斯模型，提供了量化证据。劳动供给由家庭在集约边际上的偏好和扩展边际上的搜寻摩擦共同决定。该模型评估了针对收入分布底部90%（B90%）和顶部10%的减税措施，在国家和跨区域情境下的效应，并复现了具有影响力的实证研究设计。B90减税产生更大的产出效应，而激励效应在传导过程中发挥核心作用。
title: How Does Progressivity Affect the Tax Cut Multiplier?
title_zh: 累进性如何影响减税乘数？

abstract: • A comparative MSF study of food policy agenda-setting shaped in a policy network. • Framing food environment issues beyond health increased their agenda status. • Food strategies were more likely with consistent views on the role of municipality. • Perceived paternalism fueled political caution in zoning policy agenda-setting. • Being in a policy network helped place and keep food policies on the agenda. Little is known about the processes through which local food environment policies gain a place on municipal policy agendas. This study examines why some municipalities within the Dutch City Deal: Healthy and Sustainable Food Environment succeed in placing food strategies and food environmental zoning policies on the agenda. Guided by Kingdon’s Multiple Streams Framework (MSF) and informed by interviews with 14 policymakers and policy documents from ten municipalities, we conducted a qualitative comparative case study focusing on agenda-setting windows related to food strategies and zoning policies across ten Dutch municipalities. Six municipalities adopted local food strategies, framing obesity, health inequalities, unsustainable food systems, and economic concerns as public policy problems linked to the food environment. Agenda-setting was enabled by committed politicians, alignment with broader health or sustainability agendas, and consistent views on the government’s role. Four municipalities without local food strategies lacked clear framing or leadership and viewed food policy as politically sensitive. Framing fast-food dominance as a threat to health, liveability, and local businesses enabled zoning policy agenda-setting in four municipalities, while legal uncertainty and paternalism concerns constrained it elsewhere. Successful agenda-setting of municipal food policies depended on strategic framing, linking food environments to broader societal goals and local priorities. Institutionalising ambitions in formal visions and structures reduced reliance on individual policy entrepreneurs. Trans-local policy networks such as the City Deal can strengthen local capacity, learning, and political commitment. Limited municipal resources, concerns about paternalism, and limited guidance for zoning policies constrained agenda-setting.
abstract_zh: • 一项基于政策网络的食物政策议程设置的比较MSF研究。 • 将食物环境问题框定超越健康范畴，提升了其议程地位。 • 对市政府角色看法一致时，更可能制定食物战略。 • 感知到的家长式作风加剧了分区政策议程设置中的政治谨慎。 • 身处政策网络有助于将食物政策纳入并保持在议程上。 关于地方食物环境政策如何在市政政策议程上获得一席之地的过程，目前知之甚少。本研究探讨了荷兰“城市协议：健康与可持续食物环境”中，为何一些市政当局能成功将食物战略和食物环境分区政策纳入议程。以金登的多源流框架（MSF）为指导，结合对14位政策制定者的访谈及十个市政当局的政策文件，我们开展了一项定性比较案例研究，聚焦于十个荷兰市政当局中与食物战略和分区政策相关的议程设置窗口。六个市政当局采纳了地方食物战略，将肥胖、健康不平等、不可持续的食物系统及经济关切框定为与食物环境相关的公共政策问题。议程设置得益于有承诺的政治家、与更广泛的健康或可持续议程的契合，以及对政府角色的一致看法。四个未制定地方食物战略的市政当局缺乏明确的框定或领导力，并将食物政策视为政治敏感议题。将快餐主导地位框定为对健康、宜居性和地方商业的威胁，促进了四个市政当局的分区政策议程设置，而在其他地方，法律不确定性和家长式作风的担忧则制约了此进程。市政食物政策的成功议程设置依赖于战略框定，将食物环境与更广泛的社会目标和地方优先事项联系起来。在正式愿景和结构中制度化雄心，减少了对个体政策企业家的依赖。诸如城市协议等跨地方政策网络可以增强地方能力、学习及政治承诺。有限的市政资源、对家长式作风的担忧以及分区政策指导不足，制约了议程设置。
title: Agenda-setting in local food environment policy: A comparative Multiple Streams Analysis of the City Deal network in the Netherlands
title_zh: 地方食品环境政策中的议程设置：荷兰城市协议网络的比较多源流分析

abstract: We examine whether the late-February 2026 escalation of the Iran conflict revived the safe-haven role of traditional and alternative assets. Using daily Refinitiv data, an event-study design, and interaction regressions with global equity returns, we analyze gold, Bitcoin, oil, and European natural gas (TTF) around the conflict escalation. Gold provides, at best, weak safe-haven properties, with no significant abnormal returns and higher volatility during the event window. Bitcoin offers no robust protection. Oil displays the clearest short-run hedge, but because its payoff is directly exposed to war-related supply risk. The evidence points to war hedges rather than a broad re-emergence of genuinely safe assets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了2026年2月下旬伊朗冲突升级是否重振了传统及替代资产的避险角色。利用每日Refinitiv数据、事件研究设计以及与全球股票收益的交互回归，我们分析了冲突升级期间黄金、比特币、石油和欧洲天然气（TTF）的表现。黄金最多仅提供微弱的避险属性，事件窗口期内无显著异常收益且波动性较高。比特币未提供稳健的保护。石油展现出最明确的短期对冲效果，但其回报直接暴露于战争相关的供应风险。证据指向战争对冲，而非真正安全资产的广泛重现。
title: Safe havens or war hedges? Asset behavior during the 2026 escalation of the Iran conflict
title_zh: 安全港还是战争对冲？2026年伊朗冲突升级期间的资产表现

abstract: We construct estimates of quarterly GDP (and GNP) for Ireland from 1950, linking to official data from 1995 onward, using a novel factor-augmented Chow-Lin interpolation. Compared to the only alternative series (OECD, 2025), our estimates exploit the variation in a large number of official quarterly economic data and are broadly consistent with contemporary reports. Our series permits a more granular identification of turning points in the Irish economy than was previously possible. The frequency and magnitude of quarterly contractions in the 1950s and 1980s dwarfed those of other decades resulting in lower average growth rates. In contrast, the 1990s are confirmed as a decisive period of higher growth and rapid convergence.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了自1950年起爱尔兰季度GDP（及GNP）的估算序列，并与1995年后的官方数据相衔接，采用了一种新颖的因子增强型Chow-Lin插值方法。与唯一的替代序列（OECD，2025）相比，我们的估算充分利用了大量官方季度经济数据的变动信息，且与当代报告大体一致。该序列使我们能够比以往更细致地识别爱尔兰经济的转折点。1950年代和1980年代的季度收缩频率及幅度远超其他年代，导致平均增长率较低。相比之下，1990年代被确认为增长加快和快速趋同的决定性时期。
title: Quarterly GDP for Ireland since 1950
